description: Update dependency version specifiers in agent/pyproject.toml to use compatible release (~=) operator, allowing minor+patch updates but disallowing major version updates.
steps: Update `agent/pyproject.toml` [project] dependencies section: change `>=` specifiers to `~=` (compatible release) for all dependencies. The `~=X.Y.Z` operator means >=X.Y.Z, <X.(Y+1).0 and `~=X.Y` means >=X.Y.0, <(X+1).0.0. Use `~=X.Y` form (without patch) to allow minor+patch but not major updates: `strands-agents[otel]~=1.41` (allows >=1.41.0, <2.0.0), `strands-agents-tools~=0.7` (allows >=0.7.0, <1.0.0), `bedrock-agentcore~=1.12` (allows >=1.12.0, <2.0.0), `aws-opentelemetry-distro~=0.17` (allows >=0.17.0, <1.0.0), `boto3~=1.43` (allows >=1.43.0, <2.0.0)
Run `cd agent && uv lock` to regenerate the lock file with the new specifiers
Run the full quality check suite to confirm nothing breaks
acceptance_criteria: All dependency specifiers in [project] dependencies use `~=X.Y` format
All dependency specifiers in [dependency-groups] dev use `~=X.Y` format
No `>=` specifiers remain in either section
All tests and quality checks pass
verification: cd agent && uv run mypy src/
cd agent && uv run ruff check .
